# Velora Digitizing
> Master Custom Embroidery Digitizing & Vector Art Services

Velora Digitizing provides manual embroidery digitizing, 3D puff cap digitizing, custom patch digitizing & manufacturing, and raster-to-vector artwork conversion services. Every file is manually punched and machine test-sewn before delivery.

## Key Services
- [Custom Embroidery Digitizing](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/services): Professional conversion of logos and artwork to machine stitch files (DST, PES, JEF, EXP, VP3). Turnaround in 8-24 hours.
- [3D Puff Cap Digitizing](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/services/3d-puff-digitizing): Raised dimensional foam embroidery digitizing for structured snapbacks, baseball hats, and beanies with clean column end-capping and high satin density.
- [Cap Logo Digitizing](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/services/cap-logo-digitizing): Center-out, bottom-up stitch sequencing engineered for curved 270-degree cap frames.
- [Applique Digitizing](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/services/applique-digitizing): Placement outlines, tackdown stitches, and satin cover borders for sports jerseys and varsity jackets.
- [Vector Art Conversion](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/vector-art): Manual raster-to-vector tracing delivering AI, EPS, SVG, and PDF files for screen printing and embroidery.
- [Custom Patches](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/patches): Custom patch digitizing and physical production (merrow border, laser cut, woven, PVC, chenille, iron-on, velcro).
- [Embroidery Designs Store](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/store): Instant download digital embroidery patterns and design bundles.
- [Portfolio](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/portfolio): Gallery of 3,000+ completed embroidery stitch-outs and vector designs.
- [Blog & Guides](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/blog): In-depth tutorials on Illustrator to embroidery digitizing, manual vs AI auto-digitizing, PVC vs embroidered patches, embroidery file formats (DST vs PES vs JEF), 3D puff techniques, and logo preparation.
- [How to Digitize in Illustrator](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/blog/digitize-logo-illustrator-embroidery): Complete vector preparation and DST/PES conversion guide.
- [Manual vs AI Auto-Digitizing](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/blog/manual-digitizing-vs-ai-auto-digitizing): Stitch quality, push-pull compensation, and thread break comparison.
- [PVC vs Embroidered Patches](https://www.veloradigitizing.com/blog/pvc-patches-vs-embroidered-patches): Weatherproof durability, cost, and backing options comparison.

## Technical Specifications
- Supported Output Formats: DST (Tajima), PES (Brother/Babylock), JEF (Janome), EXP (Melco/Bernina), VP3 (Husqvarna/Pfaff), XXX (Singer), SVG, AI, EPS, PDF.
- Turnaround Time: Standard 8-24 hours, Rush 2-8 hours.
